raw_response:
I am already carrying wheat on part of the land, so this year I will keep doing what feels safest for me: most of the land stays in the wheat-maize rotation, and the rest stays in cotton. On my 16.1 mu, I will put 10 mu in wheat followed by summer maize on the same land, and 6.1 mu in cotton. I am not young now, and some people in the family work outside, so I cannot make things too complicated. I will do mostly what worked before, with a little care on fertilizer and water because pumping from the well costs money. Wheat and maize are steady for grain and income, and cotton gives me another way to earn, so I do not want to give that up all at once. If the crop looks weak, I will add a little more topdressing, but I will not gamble too much on heavy spending at the start.
